title: A practical city hotel in Ternopil
description: Hotel «Passage» is a compact Ternopil hotel near the central bus station, built around straightforward rooms, 24/7 reception and easy access for transit, business and family stays.

intro.title: Convenient stays near Ternopil transport links
intro.text: Guests choose Passage Hotel for a clean, practical base close to the central bus station, with the railway station and central Ternopil roughly 1.5 km away according to public listings.
